name: speech-flow
description: Real-time speech orchestration and audio visualizer with live rolling word buffers and bidirectional Adrastea IPC bridge.

tech_stack.ipc: Socket client to Adrastea IPC host

features: Voice Activity Detection (VAD) with energy gating and silence cutoff
Push-to-Talk (PTT) keyboard controller and audio stream gate
Rolling word buffer with dynamic confidence telemetry
Bidirectional socket client connecting to Adrastea
